description: Hunter F.56 TOC 7 Jul 1959, 14 Sqn in 1965 and 1971 (Bharat Rakshak); at Leh since at least 1987, since 2003 on poles outside the airfield in grey; by 2024 wearing a spurious serial BS-230 (WBI). Visible from outside.

All-silver MiG-23BN on a platform at the north-western gate near runway 07 since 2016, painted with spurious serial SB255; seat marked SM258 (which is at UPES Dehradun); true identity unknown, possibly SM-26x (WBI, Jan 2024).
Mi-8 placed at the other end of the north-western gate with the MiG-23 in 2016 (WBI); identity unknown.
